_note: Mock insurance classes besides the house, for the hackathon demo. The house uses data/catalogue.json and data/home-profile.schema.json instead. Each class has a few profile fields and two risks. Conditions use the catalogue's applies_when grammar (scripts/catalogue/validate.py). Every number is a placeholder.

fields.name: water_winterized
fields.description: Whether the water pipes are drained for the winter.

fields.name: last_chimney_sweep
fields.description: Date of the last chimney sweep.

risks.title: Water pipes not drained for the winter

mitigation.action: A plumber drains the pipes and the water heater and closes the main valve before the frost

risks.why_hint: Water left in the pipes of an empty cottage freezes, bursts the pipes and floods the floor when it thaws.
risks.benefit_hint: Draining the pipes each autumn prevents the most common winter damage in summer cottages.

risks.title: Fireplace chimney not swept

mitigation.action: A chimney sweep cleans the flue and checks the fireplace

risks.why_hint: Soot builds up in a flue that is not swept every year and can catch fire.
risks.benefit_hint: A yearly sweep removes the soot that causes chimney fires.

fields.name: last_engine_service
fields.description: Date of the last engine service.

fields.name: winter_storage
fields.description: Where the boat spends the winter.

risks.title: Boat engine not serviced in two years

mitigation.action: A boat mechanic services the engine, the fuel line and the cooling system

risks.why_hint: An unserviced engine is the most common reason a boat breaks down or catches fire at sea.
risks.benefit_hint: A service finds worn fuel lines and impellers before they fail on the water.

risks.title: Boat stored outdoors without a cover

mitigation.action: Store the boat under a fitted winter cover or indoors

risks.why_hint: Snow and melt water collect in an uncovered boat; the weight and the frost crack the hull and the deck.
risks.benefit_hint: A cover or indoor storage keeps snow and ice out over the winter.

fields.name: winter_tyres_year
fields.description: Year the winter tyres were bought.

risks.title: Winter tyres over five years old

mitigation.action: A tyre shop checks the tread and fits new winter tyres if needed

risks.why_hint: Winter tyre rubber hardens with age and grips the ice far worse after five years.
risks.benefit_hint: New winter tyres shorten the braking distance on ice.

risks.title: Car not serviced in the last year

mitigation.action: A garage services the car and checks the brakes

risks.why_hint: Worn brakes and old fluids go unnoticed without a yearly service.
risks.benefit_hint: A yearly service keeps the brakes and the lights safe.

fields.name: vaccinations_valid
fields.description: Whether the vaccinations are up to date.

risks.title: Vaccinations not up to date
risks.why_hint: An unvaccinated dog can catch parvovirus or distemper, which need long and costly care.
risks.benefit_hint: Valid vaccinations prevent the most expensive infectious diseases.

risks.title: Older large dog without a joint check

mitigation.action: A vet checks the hips and the elbows

risks.why_hint: Large dogs over six years old often develop hip and elbow problems that get worse without care.
risks.benefit_hint: An early joint check slows the problem down and lowers the cost of care.
